title: Copy, Cut, and Paste
drDigitalIntro:
Copy, cut, and paste are the three moves you will use every day.
• Ctrl+C (or Command+C) copies the selected text — the original stays.
• Ctrl+X (or Command+X) cuts it — the original disappears.
• Ctrl+V (or Command+V) pastes whatever is in your clipboard.
• To use any of them: select the text first, then press the shortcut.
• Common mistake: pressing Ctrl+V before copying — nothing pastes because the clipboard is empty.

playgroundTask.instructions: Select the text below, press Ctrl+C (or Command+C) to copy it, click the box, then press Ctrl+V (or Command+V) to paste.

drDigitalSuccess: Copy and paste will save you so much time from here on out. Remember: copy first, then paste.
